data.description: LLM-Review advisory on S10 (52b0-6a6a-c66b-4c59, Gerrit change 2104 patchset 3, doctor_mapping.py:~220). The live-drift diff treats a configured link target absent from the probe's observed set as a drift ERROR. But the probe port's issue_link_types() is fail-soft — it returns [] on any exception (mapping_probe). So a PARTIAL probe failure (link-types API errors while statuses/types succeed) yields an empty observed link set, and EVERY configured link target then appears as drift → false-positive blocking errors, without degrading to 'unavailable'. Non-manifesting on the happy path (a full transport failure degrades to unavailable before this). Fix options: (a) skip the link axis when observed link-types is empty (can't distinguish 'no link types' from 'API failed'); (b) make the probe port distinguish empty-vs-failed for link-types and fold a link-types failure into the unavailable finding. Advisory/defensive; the drift check is best-effort and never the sole gate.
data.title: doctor live-drift: link-axis false-positive when issue_link_types() fails soft to []
